# The tracked Markdown documents: every tracked *.md outside
# conformance/upstream/ and any testdata/ directory is one row's.
# path-or-glob<TAB>budget<TAB>its one job. A glob's "*" stays inside one
# path segment; "**/" is any depth. An exact row wins over a glob, and
# names a tracked file. Budget "-" is a file not yet rewritten; a row
# whose job starts "delete:" names the unit that removes the file.
# TestDocsAreListed.
